description.value: Ayoub's is a BC-based specialty food chain selling daily in-house roasted nuts, dried fruits, seeds, sweets, and spices sourced from around the world. The Main Street Vancouver location is one of nine retail stores across the Lower Mainland and beyond. Touring cyclists will find a strong selection of high-calorie trail mixes, energy mixes, and dried fruit blends well-suited for long rides.
